name: Shattering-Cover Projection VC Dimension of Full Cube
proof: A projection to $m$ coordinates is the full $m$-cube, with $2^m$ shattered subsets. To meet the admissibility requirement $2^m\geq|\mathcal H|=2^n$ requires $m=n$. The only admissible projection is therefore the full cube, whose VC dimension is $n$. This is checked by $\texttt{sync/verify\_interpolation\_conjecture.py}$.
